company.shortDescription: We’re building AI that connects to all property databases, predicts trends, finds deals, and outshines agents, scaling to hundreds of cities
company.description: Realiste AI is a Dubai-based proptech company that uses artificial intelligence to simplify global real estate investing and property discovery. The platform analyzes massive amounts of market data, infrastructure growth, pricing trends, and investment indicators to help users identify high-potential residential properties across major cities worldwide. Realiste combines AI-driven recommendations, property analytics, valuation forecasting, and automated investment insights to make real estate decisions more transparent and data-focused.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 22.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $14,454,399 to $24,214,262, a 1.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 14 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
